name: TrilloMD
description: Generic metadata storage for AOS artifacts — entity classes, function specs, agent specs, deployment artifacts. Each row is a JSON blob keyed by name + modelClassName + appId, with versioning. The platform's pluggable metadata table.

attributes.name: activityId
attributes.description: Workflow activity that generated this item

attributes.name: fileId
attributes.description: Linked metadata file (future — enum definitions, etc.)

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: User who created or last modified this record

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number, incremented on each update. Previous version archived to TrilloMDArchive.

attributes.name: usage
attributes.description: Row classifier. Plan-29 — for AgentM rows the allowed values are: 'generativeUI' (the auto-bootstrapped UI agent; frontend implied) | 'generic' (the auto-bootstrapped Generic agent; frontend implied) | 'frontend' (application-defined interactive agent) | 'backend' (application-defined autonomous agent). Blank / null for non-AgentM rows (ClassM, FunctionM) — reserved for future use. Lookup at agent invocation time consults this column to prefer platform-shipped rows when a tenant happens to define an app agent with the same name.
